title: Phonetic profile's minimum-length floor blocks a two-character surface
why_real: Om is a short, common given name, and a user who taught the 'Ohm' spelling gets no phonetic help at all when the utterance produces the two-character 'Om' — the retriever refuses to compute a phonetic key for anything shorter than three characters, by design, to avoid short-token false positives.

expected.reason: The query surface 'om' is only two characters, below the phonetic retriever's minimum length floor, so it never gets a phonetic key; exact has no stored form for it either. Both abstain no_memory.
